_comment: Compiler flags of the retail build, per source file, for the matching compiler
first rule whose glob matches. Evidence for each rule belongs in MATCHING.md.
Game code uses $gp-relative small data (default -G8); Sony's SDK libraries and the
GCC runtime never do (-G0). crtbegin.c is collect2-generated and unoptimised ($fp frames).

not_matched._comment: GCC-runtime reimplementations used only by the GCC 14 behaviour build. The retail code is the toolchain's own libgcc.a / libstdc++.a (ref/libmatch.json), which a matching build links as the original did.
